title: Run a container from an image
goal: Start a new container from a local image in Docker Desktop

milestones.done_when: The Images page is shown, with the list of local images
hints: Left sidebar: Images (the icon under Containers when the sidebar is collapsed)
milestones.teach: An image is the template; a container is a running copy of it.

milestones.goal: Open the Run dialog for an image
milestones.done_when: The 'Run a new container' dialog is open
hints: Click the ▶ Run button in the Actions column of the image's row

milestones.done_when: Optional settings are expanded and the Container name field is filled
hints: Type a name in Container name
milestones.teach: A clear name makes the container easy to find in the list later.

milestones.done_when: The container's page shows a Running status, or the new container appears as running in the Containers list
hints: Click Run at the bottom of the dialog
